headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Full-Stack Product Engineering

bullets.text: Led engineering for new-user onboarding, increasing 7-day activation 7% and doubling feature adoption.
Shipped real-time teacher dashboards surfacing AI insights and safety violations from 17k+ daily student messages.
Build and maintain the component library that every product team at SchoolAI uses to ship features on a consistent, accessible foundation, rather than rebuilding common UI themselves.
Architected Sentinel, an AI-augmented accessibility audit harness combining deterministic tooling with LLM judgment for interpretive WCAG criteria, enabling on-demand audits.
Drove a company-critical accessibility initiative across 6 teams, closing 480 WCAG 2.1 issues and delivering SchoolAI's first VPAT, which unlocked major higher-ed and statewide deals.

Engineer reusable React and TypeScript components with a strong built-in accessibility contract, so product teams inherit WCAG conformance by using them as documented and ship fewer accessibility bugs.
Developed the React frontend for Lucid's integration marketplace, driving 14 new partner-built integrations and 540,000+ installs in its first year.
Implemented modern redesigns using SEO best practices, driving a 32% increase in clicks and 21% increase in impressions for the Lucidspark blog.
Leveraged low-level TypeScript compiler APIs to automate GraphQL schema to TypeScript type generation, eliminating a manual process and improving type safety at scale.
Built modular, performant React + TypeScript components aligned to brand standards via Styled Components, contributing to Lucid's internal design system.
Facilitated core Agile ceremonies as a team lead, improving team velocity and predictability.
Rebuilt canyonsdistrict.org from scratch, a site serving 5 million sessions per year, while reducing average page load times by 20%.
Built a centralized news publishing dashboard enabling district personnel to push content across all school-level sites, replacing a fragmented manual workflow.
Integrated custom event tracking via Google Tag Manager to analyze user engagement, providing data-backed insights that led to a complete homepage redesign.
